nodes.label: Future Work: Fine-Tune Translator on Z3-Verified Auto-Generated Pairs
nodes.norm_label: future work: fine-tune translator on z3-verified auto-generated pairs
nodes.rationale: Would teach implicit constraints (non-negativity, totality, ordering) that few-shot prompting misses, closing the solvable-class gap without changing the symbolic stage.

nodes.label: Future Work: Hybrid Translation Search with VCSearch
nodes.norm_label: future work: hybrid translation search with vcsearch

nodes.label: Few-Shot Prompted LLM Translator (Stage 1: problem -> SMT-LIB v2)
nodes.norm_label: few-shot prompted llm translator (stage 1: problem -> smt-lib v2)
nodes.rationale: LLM only describes logical structure: declare-const per unknown, assert each constraint, add non-negativity for natural quantities, check-sat/get-value; missing-info problems keep free variables.

nodes.label: Two-Stage Neuro-Symbolic Pipeline (LLM translator + Z3 judge)
nodes.norm_label: two-stage neuro-symbolic pipeline (llm translator + z3 judge)
nodes.rationale: Separating language understanding from logical evaluation keeps the LLM from fabricating answers at the reasoning step; upstream errors surface as abstentions, not confident wrong numbers. The trade-off (over-rejection) is favorable where wrong answers are costly (medical dosing, finance, grading).

nodes.label: 4-bit nf4 Quantization
nodes.rationale: Lets forward pass plus KV cache fit in one RTX A5000 (24 GB); verified not to change SMT-LIB outputs. Cited to LLM.int8() [23], although nf4 originates in QLoRA.

nodes.label: SMT-LIB Auto-Repair Pass (inject missing declare-const)
nodes.rationale: Z3 parse_smt2_string silently drops assertions using undeclared symbols; without repair 593 of 600 predictions collapsed to Missing-type.

nodes.label: Under-Constrained SMT-LIB Translation Failure Mode (~94% of solvable inputs over-abstained)
nodes.norm_label: under-constrained smt-lib translation failure mode (~94% of solvable inputs over-abstained)
nodes.rationale: Dominant error: truncated SMT-LIB, omitted implicit non-negativity (largest cause of 193 contra->missing errors), and unit mismatches SMT-LIB cannot express.

nodes.label: Z3 Judge Decision Procedure (UNSAT->Contra, unique SAT->answer, multiple models->Missing)
nodes.norm_label: z3 judge decision procedure (unsat->contra, unique sat->answer, multiple models->missing)
nodes.rationale: Uniqueness check pushes target != value and re-checks; parse errors and 5 s timeouts map to REJECT (abstain-by-default).

nodes.label: Proposed LoRA Fine-Tuned Translator (SFT on problem -> SMT-LIB pairs)
nodes.norm_label: proposed lora fine-tuned translator (sft on problem -> smt-lib pairs)
nodes.rationale: LoRA proposed to make fine-tuning LLaMA-3 feasible on limited compute. Dropped in the final paper because PMC turned out to be test-only (no training split, no answers for ill-defined rows).

nodes.label: Planned Math-Notation Text Normalization (e.g. 3/4, x**2)
nodes.rationale: Proposed to standardize notation before tokenization; the final paper deliberately feeds raw text so the translator handles real-world problem text.
